faq.q: How much does Anesi Ozmon charge?
faq.a: Anesi Ozmon publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Anesi Ozmon offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Anesi Ozmon publishes a free initial consultation.

faq.q: Where does Anesi Ozmon have offices?
faq.a: Anesi Ozmon publishes one office, in Chicago. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Anesi Ozmon?
faq.a: Anesi Ozmon names no attorney on the public pages we could read. That is a gap in what the firm publishes rather than a statement about who works there, and it is why the licensure and discipline checks on this profile have nothing to run against.

faq.q: Are the case results Anesi Ozmon publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Anesi Ozmon publishes three case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.
